A powerful-looking gull with a dark back, white head and body, a strong bill and pink legs. Compare its shape and proportions with a Herring Gull nearby.

Source: [RSPB Great Black-backed Gull guide](https://www.rspb.org.uk/birds-and-wildlife/great-black-backed-gull).
